why_points: The pick: Pass yds lower 192.5 on Underdog. Each pick has to win 56% of the time for a typical entry to make money; the sportsbooks' fair view (hardrockbet 177.5, moved to this line) is 57%.
Other apps: PrizePicks 192.5. This is the best number for the lower side.
Game log, most recent first: 149, 217, 215, 116, 305, 122. Weighted average 185.4; went lower than 192.5 in 3 of 6 games (50% recency-weighted).
How much he swings: game to game he typically moves about ±57.5, so the line is 0.1 of those swings above his average (standard deviations) — basically a coin flip.
Matchup: Kent State is about league-average against QBs.
PFF unit matchup, for context (in the 2023-25 test it added nothing to the projection, so it is not in the numbers): +8% on his average.

PFF: Kent State's coverage allows +8% yds/route vs the defenses Bowling Green has faced (all receivers, opponent-adjusted).

Keeping it honest: on their own, recent games (form) say 60% and the matchup 61%. The sportsbooks are usually close to right, and these methods have only partly beaten them (weights borrowed from NFL week 2 - college has no calibration yet), so we pull them most of the way toward the market: form 57%, matchup 58%.
Bottom line: we give it 58% to win and it needs 56%. The edge is the difference: +1.7 points; that works out to about +3¢ per $1 bet over the long run.
